description: This file is a JavaScript test script for the Thunder WiFiManager plugin, implementing websocket communication with a server, executing various tests on WiFi functionality, including scanning, connecting, and event handling.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp relative to start time.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to localhost:9998/jsonrpc.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and waits for response.

methods.name: waitEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event message from the WebSocket.

methods.name: testSetSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Tests enabling and disabling WiFi signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: testStopScanning
methods.description: Tests starting and stopping WiFi scanning via events.
